name: Harmony 650, the empty configuration built from nothing
description: todo-compile-650 11.1.1.4, one write of lab/work/empty-11-1-1/empty-step3.bin: a configuration with no device and no activity built by our own generators with no Logitech file as input, section 374. It holds the firmware's fourteen screens, an empty Devices list, an empty Activities screen and the 'Turning system off' screen, in our letters and pictures, the two menus over the idle green with white bars. Predicted: no key sends anything, so the Flirc hears nothing at all during the whole run; Devices and Activities lead to each other; an activity button shows the 'add an Activity' screen; Off shows 'Turning system off' and comes back to Activities. The three buttons below the screen are the left arrow, the centre button and the right arrow.

steps.instruction: After the write, with the cable still in, the screen should show 'USB Connected' with our USB symbol. Unplug the cable. Expect 'Turning system off' with our remote icon and three lines below it, then the Activities screen: green, 'Activities' on a white bar at the top, nothing in the middle, 'Devices' on a white bar at the bottom. Say with the mark button what it shows if it differs, and whether the corner bottom right ever shows a mark. The Flirc hears nothing
Press the centre button below the screen ('Devices'). Expect the Devices screen: green, 'Devices' at the top, nothing in the middle, 'Activities' at the bottom. The Flirc hears nothing
Press the centre button ('Activities'). Expect the Activities screen again. The Flirc hears nothing

Press Watch TV. Expect a dark screen reading 'Use the Harmony setup software to add an Activity on this button.' with 'Exit' at the bottom. Press the centre button ('Exit'). Expect to be back on the screen you came from. The Flirc hears nothing

Press More Activities. Expect to stay on, or come back to, the Activities screen; on Logitech's own compile with no activity this button shows 'Use the Harmony setup software to add Activities.' instead, so say which you see. The Flirc hears nothing
Press All Off. Expect 'Turning system off' and then the Activities screen. The Flirc hears nothing: there is no device to switch off

Leave the remote alone. Expect the screen to go dark after the 20 seconds the configuration sets, then wake it with any button and expect the Activities screen. Then press the left and right arrows below the screen and a few number keys: nothing should change and the Flirc hears nothing
